S-class docs repair: one clear sentence in the html-tier section stating that html pages use registered kebab-case type names and that the PascalCase component table is react-tier-only, placed where the html-tier reader actually looks. Sibling note for the dev: objectui carries `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` — check whether the same trap exists there and report (a cross-repo docs follow-up card is the PM's to file, not a rider). Related live defect from the same recon: objectstack-ai/objectui#6598 (html-tier `columns` binding) — docs fix here must not paper over that; the sentence documents naming, not the columns gap.

## Claim + Dispatch — R34 · serialisation cleared

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch: **`claude/issue-12650-html-tier-kebab-case`**

⭐ **This card was held behind #11585 on `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`. That hold is now released** — #11585's PR #13705 merged at 08:18Z, so the file is free. Re-derive against current `main`, ⛔ not against what the card saw when filed.

**Routing pre-check by this seat**: `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx` is hand-written — outside `content/docs/references/**` (~53% of which is generated from `packages/spec`). ⇒ ⛔ no clause ② path limb, ⛔ no spec producer. Epic #12243's `content/docs/**` slice is frontmatter/headings only; a body/table edit is outside it.

### Zone 1 — TRIAGE RULING (⛔ not re-litigable, verbatim)
> the fix lands in `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx` (verified present on this repo's `origin/main`), and content/docs/** is devx-lane surface. **S-class docs repair: one clear sentence in the html-tier section stating that html pages use registered kebab-case** …

The defect: the html tier requires **kebab-case registered names** (`<list-view>`), but the page's table shows PascalCase.

### Zone 2 — PM assumptions (⚠️ measure them)
- **A2.1** — I assume the PascalCase table is still there and still wrong. ⛔ Re-derive; #13705 just changed one line of this file.
- **A2.2** — I assume kebab-case is genuinely what the html tier registers. **Verify against the registration code**, ⛔ don't take the card's word — this card exists because a page stated the wrong casing.
- **A2.3** — I assume the fix is the table plus one sentence, not a rewrite of the tier section.

### ⛔ Boundaries
⛔ `content/docs/releases/`. ⛔ `git stash`. Dedicated worktree. Draft PR; this seat arms after review.

## ACCEPT — PR #13734

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. R34.

### What I re-derived myself (⛔ not taken on the report's word)

| Claim | Verified against `origin/main` | Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| whitelist is the manifest's own keys | `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts:41` — `const allowedTags = new Set(Object.keys(manifest.components))` | ✅ verbatim |
| manifest keyed by the registry's `type` | `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts:99-100` — `components[c.type] = { type: c.type, …` | ✅ verbatim |
| comparison is exact, no case folding | `packages/sdui-parser/src/parse.ts:61` — `!this.opts.allowedTags.has(tag)` | ✅ verbatim |
| page is hand-authored, not generated | no `AUTO-GENERATED` / `DO NOT EDIT` banner in the file | ✅ my dispatch-time routing pre-check holds |
| diff touches no heading, frontmatter or table | two body hunks, `+11 −2`, one file | ✅ clear of epic #12243's slice |

### Zone 2 outcome — one assumption falsified, one card wording corrected

- **A2.1 falsified in form.** My dispatch said "the page's **table** shows PascalCase".
  It is a **sentence** (lines 81-82 pre-diff), and the neighbouring table is the react-tier
  `What is in scope` table, which is not wrong. Had the dev worked to my wording they would
  have edited a correct table. ⭐ Re-deriving beat the dispatch note.
- **The card's own wording corrected.** "kebab-case" is the shape of the plain names, not
  the rule: 28 of 57 registered names carry a namespace prefix and four are snake_case
  after the colon (`record:related_list`, `record:line_items`, `record:quick_actions`,
  `record:reference_rail`). Documenting "kebab-case" alone would have sent an author to
  `record:related-list` — this card's own defect in a new direction. The page says
  **registered type names, written verbatim**, with kebab-case named as the shape and
  `<record:related_list>` shown. ⛔ A dev implementing the card's literal words would have
  shipped a second trap.
- **A2.2 HELD and is now measured** — the empirical probe (`compile()` against the real
  57-component manifest) reproduces the reporter's symptom exactly: `ListView` → `ListView
  is not an allowed component`, `list-view` → accepted.
- **A2.3 HELD** — one paragraph plus a scoping clause; no restructure.

### Gates

25 GREEN / 0 RED / 1 NOT MEASURED at the final commit `6c5a1a754`, family list re-derived
after the commit. NOT MEASURED is `scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` (exit 3,
`PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — it grades a saved `turbo run test` log no local run produced, and
its own text says to record it as NOT MEASURED). ⭐ Three gates that first returned
PREREQUISITE NOT MET for unbuilt packages were **built and re-run to green**, not counted
as findings. Declared narrowing on repo-wide ESLint is measured, not asserted: the path is
outside ESLint's configured set (`File ignored because no matching configuration was
supplied`), the diff touches no ESLint config, and no type-aware linting is involved.

`skip-changeset` is correct and consistent with recent `content/docs/**`-only merges.

### The two follow-ups this card generated — both filed, ⛔ neither ridden into this PR

- **objectstack-ai/objectui#7006** — the same trap on `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md`
  in the sibling repo. Triage's first-touch reserved this for the PM ("a cross-repo docs
  follow-up card is the PM's to file, not a rider") and the dev correctly handed it up with
  evidence instead of filing or fixing it. Verified independently by this seat against
  objectui's `origin/main`, and duplicate-checked across 271 open issues there.
- **#13737** (`finding`) — the page is the docs home for **both** tiers per three
  `pages.mdx` link sites, yet all 11 sections below the security gate are unmarked
  react-only material (`## record:* blocks are not in this tier` is the sharpest instance).
  That is a docs-architecture question with more than one defensible answer, so it is filed
  for grading, ⛔ not dispatched.

`objectstack-ai/objectui#6598` (html-tier `columns` binding) is untouched and unpapered-over,
as triage required.

### Disposition

⛔ Not governed surface (one `content/docs/**` file) and no clause ② limb — no path hit, no
`Clause-②: yes` declaration, no `needs:contract-review` on the card. **Arming as soon as the
six pending checks settle green**; `Fixes #12650` closes this card on merge.
